items.rationale: Re-evaluated under docs/sense-division.md ('A grammatical-frame change or a new preposition alone is not sufficient to split') and docs/ontology-v1.md §1.2 ('Construction owns syntax and valency'). Intransitive machine functioning ('The engine runs quietly') and transitive machine/program operation ('run a machine/program') form a productive causative/inchoative (ergative) alternation sharing the same core operational state, truth conditions (X runs Y entails Y runs), and selectional domain (machine/system). Both OALD (run_1 sense 7 [I, T]) and Cambridge (run OPERATE [I or T]) keep both frames in a single sense. Therefore, Option 2 (Retain single ambitransitive sense 'sense-run-machine' with its two attached Construction records and two contextual TranslationEquivalence records) is superior to splitting. However, Phase 9 COR-003 updated grammar.transitivity to 'ambitransitive' without broadening sense-run-machine's definition ('Function or operate, especially of a machine or system.'), which currently covers only the intransitive frame. Broadening /entity/definition and purging workflow meta-language from usageNote, con.constraints, and eqv.restrictions resolves the issue without a sense split.
evidence: SRC-OALD: run_1 verb sense 7 ([I, T] of a machine: to operate or function; to make a machine do this)
SRC-HOANG-PHE: hoạt động (intransitive) vs vận hành (transitive/technical)
counterEvidence: Current sense-run-machine /entity/definition states only 'Function or operate, especially of a machine or system.', omitting the causative transitive reading.
items.proposedCorrection: Retain single ambitransitive sense-run-machine; update /entity/definition to 'Function or operate, especially of a machine or system, or cause a machine, system, or program to function.'; clean workflow meta-language in usageNote, construction-run-machine-transitive/constraints/0, equiv-run-machine-operate/restrictions/0, and equiv-run-machine-operate-alternative/restrictions/0..1.
